messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD#44321 - GPU memory pressure detected in us-west1-gpupool (severity: P1). Autoscale attempted, some tasks evicted. See dashboard: https://internal.redwood/dashboard/alerts/44321

pagerduty: PD#44321 assigned to on-call (alex_onsite). Please acknowledge.

alex_onsite: Acked — jumping in. Checking pool state now.

jamie_sre: Thanks. Can you confirm if this is single-node or multi-node spread? Looks like prefetch thrash in kvcache metrics.

alex_onsite: Early glance — ~4 nodes showing rising nvml OOM counters, spool of small jobs causing fragmentation. Error snippet from node-gpu-07:
```
NVIDIA-SMI: GPU memory allocation failed: out of memory
E CudaDriver: cuMemAlloc failed (out of memory)
nvmlDeviceGetMemoryInfo returned 2 (insufficient funds)
```

ravi_ml: Those nodes were running large kv-cache fill workloads for retriever B. Could be an eviction storm when prefix cache miss rate spiked. I can throttle prefetch on that job.

alex_onsite: Initiating immediate mitigation: 1) cordon node-gpu-07 and node-gpu-12, 2) restart worker process on node-gpu-09 to clear KV caches, 3) enable model-fallback routing for latency-sensitive routes.

emily_support: Customer impact: Support telemetry shows elevated error rates for two enterprise customers (acct-redwood-inc, acct-zenberta) — error rate +6% on inference, some 5xxs. Notified account reps.

noah_pm: Do we need to open an incident page? Customers asking for ETA.

jamie_sre: Yes, open incident page. I'm assigning incident commander to alex_onsite unless you want to hand off.

alex_onsite: I'll take IC. Creating incident doc: https://internal.redwood/incidents/2026-03-17-gpu-memory-surge-44321 — adding timeline and runbook steps.

pagerduty: PD#44321 acknowledged by alex_onsite at 1763141605. Escalation route will trigger in 8m if not resolved.

ravi_ml: Throttled prefetch on retriever-B job and applied a soft-evict policy. Monitoring KV cache hit/miss and evictions.

alex_onsite: Cordon + drain in progress. node-gpu-07 drained, node-gpu-12 draining. Traffic rerouted to lower-memory models for affected routes. Latency back to baseline for most customers.

emily_support: Update sent to acct-redwood-inc: brief apology, mitigation steps, and ETA for full recovery ~30m.

jamie_sre: Great. Can ops post exact metrics to incident doc (eviction count, reclaim latency, #affected requests)? We'll need them for RCA.

alex_onsite: Adding metrics now. Current snapshot: eviction spikes peaked at 220 evictions/min, reclaim latency 1200ms, ~11% of requests experienced transient 5xxs during peak window.

incident-bot: Resolution timer started. Will post follow-ups when PD resolves.

pagerduty: PD#44321 marked resolved at 1763141698 by alex_onsite. Root mitigation: KV-prefetch throttle + node drains. Recommend follow-up: config change to prefetch concurrency and add mem-frag alarms to catch pre-eviction stages. :white_check_mark:

jamie_sre: Marking for RCA. Assigning to ravi_ml and alex_onsite. Thanks everyone — good triage. :thumbsup:

noah_pm: Noted for customer comms and feature impact.

emily_support: Will follow up with affected customers with detailed incident summary and credits if needed.

alex_onsite: Closing thread here, continuing RCA in incident doc.
